summary: A Gilmer County tower list names a rich mtn lookout with an elevation of 4,047 (read as feet); a Komoot route page says a CCC tower once stood on the summit. Unverified.

facts.status_note: Only a tower list and an unverified route-page claim name a tower here. No source confirms a tower on the summit now.

notes_for_editor: The only source for a tower on the summit is a Komoot route page, which gives no dates or citations for the CCC claim. The list entry has no notes. The searches turned up a Rich Mountain fire tower near Hot Springs, Madison County, North Carolina, which is a different tower and is not used here. The list coordinates sit near the wilderness's listed coordinates, so the tower may or may not lie inside the wilderness; no source settles that. Checking the Chattahoochee National Forest ranger district or the Georgia Forestry Commission would be the next step.
